items.title: New Cardinals QB Johnson, on 15th team, set to start with Beck out
items.description: Cardinals rookie quarterback Carson Beck has been downgraded to out, paving the way for 40-year-old Josh Johnson to start against the Chiefs.

items.title: Michael Pittman: Will not return this week
items.description:
Pittman (foot) is not expected to be activated from injured reserve for Sunday's game against the Eagles, Brooke Pryor of ESPN reports.

items.title: Colts cut ties with QB Jones, turn to Richardson for next start
items.description: The Colts have cut quarterback Daniel Jones after a challenging 11-game stint in 2026 and are turning to Anthony Richardson Sr. to start going forward.

items.title: Carson Beck: Officially ruled out
items.description:
Beck (back) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Kansas City, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Melo calls out Humphrey for Baltimore remark: Back your apology with action
items.description: Former NBA star Carmelo Anthony challenged Ravens cornerback Marlon Humphrey to do more than apologize after he said Baltimore was "best at making criminals."

items.title: Tyjae Spears: Lands on injured reserve
items.description:
The Titans placed Spears (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

items.title: Titans DL Harrell hospitalized after car accident in Tampa
items.description: Titans defensive lineman Jaylen Harrell was involved in a serious car accident Friday and remains hospitalized, according to the team.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: Practicing Saturday
items.description:
Jacobs (finger) is participating in Saturday's practice session, Bill Huber of SI.com reports.

items.title: Steelers activate WR Wilson off IR for Eagles game
items.description: The Steelers have activated wide receiver Roman Wilson from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game against the Eagles.

items.title: Rachaad White: Expected to play Monday
items.description:
White (heel) is trending toward being available for Monday's game against the Bengals, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

items.title: Raiders owner Davis upset by 'Madden' version of his father: 'Totally unfair'
items.description: Saying "I did the best I could to protect him," Raiders owner Mark Davis expressed frustration with the depiction of his father, the late Al Davis, in the new movie "Madden."

items.title: Chiefs again without RB Walker against Cardinals
items.description: Chiefs RB Kenneth Walker III will not play in Sunday's game against the Cardinals after not participating in practice this week due to a groin injury.
